beliefs: The box reverses the order of characters in the input string [E1]
All Unicode whitespace characters are removed from the output rather than preserved [E2, E5, E8]
Reversal happens first, then whitespace is stripped from the reversed result [E2, E4, E15]
Case, digits, symbols, and non-whitespace invisible/format characters (ZWJ, ZWNJ, BOM, soft hyphen, word joiner) are preserved as-is, only order changes and whitespace is dropped [E1, E9]
The reversal is by UTF-16 code unit, not by grouped code point: a valid astral pair next to a lone surrogate gets split apart, so '\ud83d\ude00\ud800' -> '\ud800\ude00\ud83d' [E23]
Lone surrogates and unpaired UTF-16 code units are reversed as individual code units without error or alteration [E11, E12]
A surrogate pair split by whitespace is NOT recombined: the two halves reverse as separate code units, so '\ud83d \ude00' -> '\ude00\ud83d' [E13, E14]
Whitespace between a lone high and lone low surrogate is removed but the halves are never merged into an astral character [E18, E19]
The box reverses first, then strips whitespace, so whitespace removal never causes new surrogate pairs to merge [E19]
Because reversal is plain code-unit reversal, adjacent valid surrogate pairs are NOT grouped as units; each code unit reverses independently [E23]
notes: E23 shows plain code-unit reversal: a valid astral pair adjacent to a lone surrogate gets split (e.g. '\ud83d\ude00\ud800' -> '\ud800\ude00\ud83d'), so I removed the surrogate-pair grouping from predict(). This also explains the earlier E11/E13/E14 mismatches.
